audit_basis: All 20 training jobs had passed the frozen training-source guard and written RUNNING.json before the later filesystem writes.
A timestamp audit over every Python file included in the training runtime hash identified config/analysis.py as the only path written after training submission and startup.

The repository diff for that path adds defaults and validation for disabled information, path-matched-information, and receptive-field analyses; it does not modify model, network, dataset, optimizer, trainer, checkpoint, or forward code.
The exact extension base YAML contains analysis: {}, so the added analysis fields are not enabled during training or frozen-bank evaluation.
Evaluation additionally reconstructs the standard model, strictly loads the checkpoint, requires final and best state dictionaries to be identical, and runs a bitwise population no-op forward audit.
scientific_interpretation: The observed source-hash difference is analysis-configuration-only drift and is not expected to change model construction or predictions. It is disclosed because byte-for-byte identity of the broad package hash is not claimed.
limitations: This attestation is a scoped filesystem/diff audit, not a proof of platform invariance.
The extension remains a paired completion of the cube and is not an independent replication.
